product.name: ShiftHarbor
product.description: A web application that community food banks use to publish volunteer shifts, let volunteers sign up for and swap shifts, and track hours served. This report covers the volunteer portal and the coordinator dashboard.

methods:
Tested by Lanternfish's in-house accessibility team between 14 September and 9 October 2026 against ShiftHarbor 3.1 on the staging environment.
Manual testing: keyboard-only operation; NVDA 2026.3 with Firefox 141 and JAWS 2026 with Chrome 140 on Windows 11; VoiceOver with Safari 19 on macOS 16 and iOS 20; TalkBack with Chrome on Android 16; 200% and 400% browser zoom; Windows high-contrast mode.
Automated testing: axe-core 4.11 on every page template, and a colour-contrast analyser on the design tokens.
In scope: sign-in, the shift calendar, shift sign-up and swap, the hours log, profile settings and the coordinator dashboard. Out of scope: the CSV export files and the printable rota.
notes:
This report, its product, its vendor and its findings are fictional, written to illustrate the template.
The calendar drag-and-drop and dashboard chart issues described below are scheduled to be fixed in release 3.2.

criteria.label: Non-text Content
criteria.remarks: Icons and images have text alternatives. The hours-served chart on the coordinator dashboard has no text alternative or data table, so its figures are not available to screen reader users.

criteria.label: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no audio-only or video-only content.

criteria.label: Captions (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Audio Description or Media Alternative (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Captions (Live)
criteria.remarks: The product has no live audio or video.

criteria.label: Audio Description (Prerecorded)
criteria.remarks: The product has no prerecorded video.

criteria.label: Info and Relationships
criteria.remarks: Headings, lists, landmarks and form labels are marked up correctly. The shift calendar's month grid is built from generic elements without table or grid semantics, so day and column headers are not announced.

criteria.label: Meaningful Sequence
criteria.remarks: The reading order in the markup matches the visual order on every page tested.

criteria.label: Sensory Characteristics
criteria.remarks: Instructions do not rely on shape, position or sound alone; for example, "Use the Swap button in the shift details" names the control.

criteria.label: Orientation
criteria.remarks: Every page works in portrait and landscape orientation.

criteria.label: Identify Input Purpose
criteria.remarks: Profile and sign-up fields carry the matching autocomplete values (name, email, tel, street-address).

criteria.label: Use of Color
criteria.remarks: Most status is shown in text as well as colour. On the shift calendar, full shifts are distinguished from open shifts by colour alone.

criteria.label: Audio Control
criteria.remarks: The product plays no audio.

criteria.label: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Text meets a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) in the default theme.

criteria.label: Resize Text
criteria.remarks: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.

criteria.label: Images of Text
criteria.remarks: The product uses no images of text other than the logo.

criteria.label: Reflow
criteria.remarks: Pages reflow at 320 CSS pixels without horizontal scrolling, except the coordinator dashboard's roster table, which scrolls in two directions.

criteria.label: Non-text Contrast
criteria.remarks: Form field borders, focus indicators and icons meet a contrast ratio of at least 3:1.

criteria.label: Text Spacing
criteria.remarks: No content is lost or clipped when text spacing is overridden as the criterion describes.

criteria.label: Content on Hover or Focus
criteria.remarks: Tooltips stay visible while hovered, can be dismissed with Escape, and remain until the pointer or focus leaves.

criteria.label: Keyboard
criteria.remarks: All functions work from a keyboard except moving a shift on the coordinator calendar, which needs drag and drop. Coordinators can move a shift from the keyboard through the shift's Edit form instead, but the drag handle itself is not keyboard operable.

criteria.label: No Keyboard Trap
criteria.remarks: No keyboard trap was found; focus leaves every dialog with Escape or the Close button.

criteria.label: Character Key Shortcuts
criteria.remarks: The product has no single-character keyboard shortcuts.

criteria.label: Timing Adjustable
criteria.remarks: The session warns two minutes before it times out after 30 minutes of inactivity, and lets the user extend it with a single action.

criteria.label: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.remarks: The product has no moving or auto-updating content other than the sign-up confirmation banner, which stays until dismissed.

criteria.label: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.remarks: No content flashes.

criteria.label: Bypass Blocks
criteria.remarks: A Skip to main content link is the first focusable element on every page.

criteria.label: Page Titled
criteria.remarks: Every page has a title that names the page and the product.

criteria.label: Focus Order
criteria.remarks: Focus moves in a logical order; dialogs take focus on opening and return it to the triggering control on closing.

criteria.label: Link Purpose (In Context)
criteria.remarks: Link text, together with its context, says where each link goes.

criteria.label: Multiple Ways
criteria.remarks: Pages are reached through the main navigation, the search box and the site map.

criteria.label: Headings and Labels
criteria.remarks: Headings and labels describe their topic or purpose.

criteria.label: Focus Visible
criteria.remarks: Every focusable element shows a visible focus outline.

criteria.label: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: On narrow screens, the sticky footer bar can hide the focused field at the bottom of the shift sign-up form.

criteria.label: Pointer Gestures
criteria.remarks: Every multipoint or path-based gesture has a single-pointer alternative.

criteria.label: Pointer Cancellation
criteria.remarks: Actions run on the up event.

criteria.label: Label in Name
criteria.remarks: The accessible names of controls contain their visible labels.

criteria.label: Motion Actuation
criteria.remarks: No function is operated by device motion.

criteria.label: Dragging Movements
criteria.remarks: Moving a shift on the coordinator calendar needs a dragging movement. The shift's Edit form offers a single-pointer alternative, but the calendar gives no hint of it.

criteria.label: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels or have enough spacing.

criteria.label: Language of Page
criteria.remarks: Every page declares its language.

criteria.label: Language of Parts
criteria.remarks: Passages in another language, such as the Spanish welcome text, are marked with their language.

criteria.label: On Focus
criteria.remarks: Receiving focus does not change the context.

criteria.label: On Input
criteria.remarks: Changing a setting does not change the context until the user selects Save.

criteria.label: Consistent Navigation
criteria.remarks: The navigation appears in the same order on every page.

criteria.label: Consistent Identification
criteria.remarks: Components with the same function are labelled the same way throughout.

criteria.label: Consistent Help
criteria.remarks: The Help link appears in the same place in the header on every page.

criteria.label: Error Identification
criteria.remarks: Errors are described in text next to the field, and summarised at the top of the form.

criteria.label: Labels or Instructions
criteria.remarks: Every field has a visible label, and required fields are marked in text.

criteria.label: Error Suggestion
criteria.remarks: Error messages suggest a correction where one is known, such as the expected date format.

criteria.label: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.remarks: The product makes no legal commitments or financial transactions, and does not modify or delete user data in storage without confirmation.

criteria.label: Redundant Entry
criteria.remarks: Information entered earlier in a process, such as the volunteer's contact details, is filled in again or offered for selection.

criteria.label: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
criteria.remarks: Sign-in allows password managers and pasting; a one-time email link is offered as an alternative.

criteria.label: Name, Role, Value
criteria.remarks: Standard controls expose their name, role and value. The custom shift-type picker does not expose its expanded state or the selected option.

criteria.label: Status Messages
criteria.remarks: Saving the profile announces a status message. Signing up for a shift shows a confirmation banner that screen readers do not announce.
